title.narrative: Frontier Technologies for Inclusive Circularity of Low Value Plastics (LVP)

description.narrative:
Based on an initial analysis of plastic waste generation, collection, disposal, recycling and associated challenges in the Eastern region of the country, UN-Habitat has proposed the city of Bhubaneswar (Odisha) of India based on consultations and assurance of support for the proposed project from city functionaries in order to demonstrate plastic waste upcycling interventions to showcase scalability of these pilots so that they can be replicated in other cities in the eastern region and the rest of the country.
A matrix of all mechanical recycling / upcycling technologies was developed to better understand opportunities, technical aspects, challenges and case studies. Based on this matrix and detailed consultations with municipal functionaries and technology providers, two frontier technological interventions have been selected for scaling up as part of the proposed project adopting the topmost level of the waste hierarchy (which is plastic to plastic).
Project Objective: To demonstrate sustainable circularity of low value waste plastics through the application of frontier and emerging technologies in an inclusive manner in Eastern India region.
